Tepidly means the same as lukewarmly.
terrestrially: Terrestrially means in a worldly manner.
Terrestrially can also mean to a land environment.
Terrestrially means the same as mundanely.
terribly: Terribly can also mean in a terrible manner.
Terribly means the same as awfully or awful or frightfully.
terrifically: For example: "Her voice is superbly disciplined."
Terrifically means the same as wonderfully or wondrous or wondrously.
territorially: Territorially means with respect to territory.
tersely: Tersely means in a short and concise manner.
For example: "A particular bird, exactly and tersely described in the book of birds."
Tersely means the same as telegraphically.
testily: Testily means in a petulant manner.
Testily means the same as irritably or petulantly or pettishly.
tetchily: Tetchily means in an ill-natured and tetchy manner.
For example: "`Are you sure?' he asked her tetchily."
tete a tete: Tete a tete means without the intrusion of a third person.
